final_message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The bug is in the vendored `slugify`, which drops accented letters. I didn't touch it, because `vendor/` is off-limits. Instead, `src/blog/slug.js` now strips the accents before calling `slugify`.

Shop product URLs (`src/shop/product-url.js`) call `slugify` directly, so they still drop accented letters. If you want the same fix there, the real fix is in the vendored library, which the platform team would need to make.
